WP-21 is now `in-progress` and committed in `../shared_compnents` (`4e81b83` on `master`, not pushed). I did not change WP-12; it still reads `review`.

The repo's `AGENTS.md` says: "OrthoQM rows are owned by the OrthoQM team. 3DQM sessions edit only rows marked `3DQM`." WP-12 is an OrthoQM row, so I asked before touching it, and the question went unanswered.

If you do have the authority to change that row, say so and I'll set WP-12 to `done` in a second commit. Otherwise the OrthoQM team needs to update it.
